implementation.name: Gn W (MiSTer)
implementation.notes: Source availability (T5.4): open -- the repository carries 9 HDL source files (3 systemverilog, 6 verilog) alongside 3 prebuilt .rbf binaries. There is no open_source column in the delivered schema (data-model.md §1.9 deleted the proposed core table together with its flags); the presence of hdl_language_id and of implementation_path rows is how that fact is stated here. Machines unmapped: as with GameAndWatch_MiSTer, MAME models Game & Watch titles individually and no single machine_id describes the core. License: https://github.com/MiSTer-devel/GnW_MiSTer/blob/master/LICENSE is the verbatim GNU GPL version 2 text, and the grant in https://github.com/MiSTer-devel/GnW_MiSTer/blob/master/GnW.sv reads "either version 2 of the License, or (at your option) any later version" -- hence GPL-2.0-or-later. hdl_language_id: no single HDL family reaches 90% of the 9 source files (3 systemverilog, 6 verilog), excluding the shared framework directory. accuracy_id omitted: the repository makes no timing-fidelity claim this build could verify.
